description: This file defines the ArchiveFragment class, a UI component for displaying and managing archived notes within an Android application. It extends AbstractNotesFragment and manages UI interactions such as menu options, note selection, and navigation to other screens.

classes.name: ArchiveFragment
classes.description: A fragment responsible for displaying archived notes, handling user interactions like searching, selecting, and navigating to note editors or search screens.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu for the fragment. Deprecated method, used to set up menu options for archive-specific actions.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item clicks, navigating to search, toggling hidden notes, or selecting all notes based on the clicked item.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles click events on notes, navigating to the note editor with transition animations.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long click events on notes, typically triggering selection or contextual menu.
